encodedlogistics:network_controller.shift: The heart of a network. Forms hollow frames up to 7x7x7.

encodedlogistics:power_inlet.shift: Feeds FE into the network through its port. Cables attach to the other five faces.

encodedlogistics:creative_capacitor_bank.shift: Creative only. Endless network energy: always full, gives any FE asked and takes any offered, on its network and every face.

encodedlogistics:segment_isolator.shift: Splits a network: lanes and storage do not pass through.

encodedlogistics:cable_anchor.shift: Mount on a cable face to stop it connecting that way.

encodedlogistics:cable_facade.shift: Covers any face of a cable. Use a block on a placed facade to give it that block's look; sneak-use it with an empty hand to take the block back off.

encodedlogistics:lithography_press.shift: Etches dies from silicon wafers with a reusable photomask. Runs on FE; no network needed.

encodedlogistics:drive_bay.shift: Holds ten Storage Drives and makes them the network's storage. Uses one lane.

Reusable - not consumed by the Lithography Press

encodedlogistics:fuzzy_match_module.shift: Port and Collector Plane filters match by tag or damage: right-click a filter entry to pick.

lines: Ports respond to redstone: high, low or pulse
encodedlogistics:redstone_control_module.shift: Unlocks a port's redstone modes: active with signal, without signal, or once per pulse.

encodedlogistics:schematic_card.shift: A blank card for the Schematic Encoder to write a recipe onto.

encodedlogistics:encoded_schematic_craft.shift: A crafting recipe. Put it in a Fabricator so the network can craft it.

encodedlogistics:encoded_schematic_proce.shift: Inputs and outputs for a machine. Put it in a Gateway next to the machine.

encodedlogistics:fabricator.shift: Crafts the recipes on its Crafting Schematics for the network's Schedulers. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:gateway.shift: Runs Processing Schematics through the machines next to it, and keeps items stocked for them. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:scheduler_core.shift: The heart of a Scheduler: plans and runs crafting jobs. Build a solid cuboid of Scheduler blocks with one Core.

encodedlogistics:job_buffer.shift: Scheduler block: adds job memory for bigger jobs.

encodedlogistics:thread_unit.shift: Scheduler block: one more thread. Another job at a time, or more crafts at once for a large job.

encodedlogistics:optical_transceiver.shift: An optical module for wireless and long-range links. Each one in a Relay Antenna adds 32 blocks of range; in a Router, 16 items/s.

encodedlogistics:link_card.shift: Pairs Network Bridges and Point-to-Point Links, and links segments and networks to rack devices. Sneak-use on one to store it, then use on its partner (a segment - a Segment Isolator - on a rack's switch; a network - any block of it - on a Router). Sneak-use in the air to clear.

encodedlogistics:cross_connect.shift: Use on a Router's unit in an open rack, then on an Exchange Switch: the Router joins the exchange (or asks to).

lines: Blank - sneak-use on a rack to copy it, or use to plan
Use on a Relay Antenna or Network Controller to link
encodedlogistics:handheld_terminal.shift: A terminal that works in range of its network's Relay Antennas. Charges in FE chargers, or held against a Capacitor Bank.

encodedlogistics:relay_antenna.shift: Wireless coverage for Handheld Terminals linked to its network: 32 blocks, more with Optical Transceivers. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:exchange_switch.shift: An Internet Exchange, two blocks tall: Routers on any networks join it with a Cross-Connect and peer there, through its route server or with each other. Uses one lane; its owner approves members. Keeps its chunk loaded while it has members.

encodedlogistics:directory_server.shift: Publishes devices of its network so other networks' Terminal OS can reach them as SYSNAME/DEVICE (through a Router's Control policy, with the Firewall's say there). Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:network_bridge.shift: Joins two networks, any distance apart, with a 32-lane link. Pair two with a Link Card; both ends must be loaded.

encodedlogistics:radio_module.shift: The radio in Access Points, Wireless Bridges and Wireless Ports.

encodedlogistics:midrange_system.shift: Runs its network and the Terminal OS from one cabinet, with crafting threads and diskette recipes. An Expansion Cabinet beside it adds more.

encodedlogistics:expansion_cabinet.shift: Stands beside a Midrange System, facing the same way: one more crafting thread, diskette slot and batch job.

encodedlogistics:integrated_midrange.shift: A bigger Midrange System with its own console and a diskette magazine unit: runs its network, the Terminal OS and crafting.

encodedlogistics:keypunch.shift: Punches a crafting recipe, typed in by item name, onto blank Punch Cards. Needs a Midrange System online on its network.

encodedlogistics:card_reader.shift: Reads the punched cards in its hopper onto the 8" Diskette in its slot, a recipe a card. Needs a Midrange System online on its network.

encodedlogistics:line_printer.shift: Prints reports and spooled files onto Printouts, a page per paper. Load paper by using it on the printer. Works on any running network: cable it to a Terminal Desk's, a server rack's or a Midrange System's.

encodedlogistics:disk_drive.shift: One Storage Drive as hot storage, like a Drive Bay slot. Uses a lane.

encodedlogistics:tape_drive.shift: One Tape Reel as cold storage, beside the Tape Libraries. Uses a lane.

encodedlogistics:printout.shift: Line printer output. Use it to read it; hold it to see its page.

encodedlogistics:tape_reel.shift: Cold storage for a Tape Drive.

lines: Blank - punch a recipe on a Card Punch
Blank - write it on a Card Reader

encodedlogistics:access_point.shift: The radio for its network's Wireless Controller. Mount it on a cable (or any network block); each one online lets the controller serve 8 Wireless Bridges and Ports.

encodedlogistics:wireless_bridge.shift: Brings what's cabled to it onto its Wireless Controller's network, anywhere, with up to 32 lanes. Link it with a Link Card from the controller.

encodedlogistics:wireless_ingress_port.shift: An Ingress Port with no cable: mount it on an inventory and link it to a Wireless Controller with a Link Card.

encodedlogistics:wireless_egress_port.shift: An Egress Port with no cable: mount it on an inventory and link it to a Wireless Controller with a Link Card.

encodedlogistics:display_panel.shift: Shows text, gauges, graphs and tables that ELCL scripts send it. Panels side by side or stacked join into one screen. Uses a lane.

encodedlogistics:small_wireless_bridge.shift: Goes on a face of an Arcforge machine. Linked with a Link Card from a Wireless Controller, it puts the machine on that network: Work with Machines, ELCL, Gateways and graphs can see and work it. Sneak-use with an empty hand to take it off.

encodedlogistics:server_rack.shift: A 42U rack, 1 wide, 3 tall and 2 deep, for Firewalls, Routers and UPSes. Cables join it at the back and on top. Right-click the front or back to open its doors; sneak-right-click the front for its screen.

encodedlogistics:terminal_desk.shift: A green-screen terminal on a desk: the network's items, jobs and devices in text mode, and a command line. Its drawer takes withdrawals.

encodedlogistics:control_interface.shift: Redstone in and out for ELCL scripts, a channel on each face: RTVRSIN reads one, CHGRSOUT sets one. Set up from the terminal. Uses a lane.

encodedlogistics:plc.shift: A Programmable Logic Controller: runs one ELCL program over and over, like a PLC scan. Each face reads and drives redstone. Four slots for sensor modules. Runs on FE, or on its network when cabled to one. Right-click for its screens.

encodedlogistics:presence_sensor.shift: PLC module: counts players, mobs or both within a radius (1-16). RTVSNSVAL reads it.

encodedlogistics:inventory_sensor.shift: PLC module: how full the container on a face is (percent) and its item count.

encodedlogistics:fluid_sensor.shift: PLC module: how full the tank on a face is (percent) and its amount in mB.

encodedlogistics:light_sensor.shift: PLC module: the light level at the PLC (0-15), and whether it's day or night.

encodedlogistics:timer_module.shift: PLC module: the game clock - ticks, and the day and time.

encodedlogistics:eeprom_cartridge.shift: Holds a PLC program. Hold it and pick 4 (save) or 5 (load) on a PLC's status screen.

encodedlogistics:swivel_chair.shift: Sit on it; it turns with you. Dye it in a crafting grid.

encodedlogistics:firewall.shift: A 1U rack device: decides who may view, insert, extract, craft and build on its network. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:router.shift: A 1U rack device: moves items between separate networks, any distance apart, 16 items/s and 16 more for each Optical Transceiver. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:ups.shift: A 2U rack device: a 1,000,000 FE battery that covers its network when supply falls short, and recharges from the surplus. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:l2_switch_24.shift: A 1U rack device: 16 rack-local lanes for the other devices in its rack, which then take no network lanes; it uses one.

encodedlogistics:l2_switch_48.shift: A 1U rack device: 32 rack-local lanes for the other devices in its rack, which then take no network lanes; it uses one.

encodedlogistics:l3_switch.shift: A 1U rack device: an L2 Switch with 32 lanes that also routes items between segments, with QoS priorities.

encodedlogistics:compute_server.shift: A 2U rack device: 2 crafting threads. With a Memory Server on the same network, in any rack, the network's racks pool into one Scheduler.

encodedlogistics:memory_server.shift: A 1U rack device: 32K job memory. With a Compute Server on the same network, in any rack, the network's racks pool into one Scheduler.

encodedlogistics:fabrication_server.shift: A 2U rack device: a Fabricator for nine Crafting Schematics, offered the rack Scheduler's crafts first.

encodedlogistics:directory_server_rack.shift: A 1U rack device: a Directory Server. Publishes devices of its network so other networks can reach them as SYSNAME/DEVICE. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:monitoring_server.shift: A 1U rack device: graphs its network's item flow, energy use, lanes and crafting over the last minute to the last day.

encodedlogistics:nas.shift: A 2U rack device: six Storage Drives as network storage, with a priority and access mode.

encodedlogistics:san.shift: A 4U rack device: 24 Storage Drives as network storage; needs an Optical Transceiver in its rear cages.

encodedlogistics:rack_console.shift: A 1U rack device: an Access Terminal in a drawer. Right-click it through the open front to slide it out, again for the terminal.

encodedlogistics:rack_fabrication_consol.shift: A 1U rack device: a Fabrication Terminal in a drawer, its crafting grid kept in the console. Right-click it through the open front to slide it out, again for the terminal.

encodedlogistics:rack_schematic_console.shift: A 1U rack device: a Schematic Terminal in a drawer. Right-click it through the open front to slide it out, again for the terminal.

encodedlogistics:wireless_controller.shift: A 1U rack device: Handheld Terminals linked to it (use one on its rack) work anywhere, in any dimension. Use a Link Card on its unit, then on a Wireless Bridge or Port, to link those; they need Access Points on the network. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:tape_library_4u.shift: A 4U rack device: 24 LTO tapes as cold storage, 2 drive bays. Archives items left untouched, and recalls them when they're asked for.

encodedlogistics:tape_library_6u.shift: A 6U rack device: 48 LTO tapes as cold storage, 4 drive bays. Archives items left untouched, and recalls them when they're asked for.

encodedlogistics:lto_tape_drive.shift: Reads and writes LTO tapes in a Tape Library's drive bay.

encodedlogistics:optical_multiplexer.shift: Carries 8 client networks as channels over one Fiber Cable line to a matching multiplexer (paired with a Link Card): each channel joins the network given to it here (a Link Card from any of its blocks) with the one on the same channel at the far end, up to a Fiber Cable's lanes less the line's span loss. Its line port is its front; the networks on the line itself stay apart. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:optical_amplifier.shift: Placed inline on a Fiber Cable run (light in at the back, out at the front), it ends the span it's on while powered, so span loss counts again from it. Unpowered it just passes the light through. Powered by its network, or by an online multiplexer or shelf whose line runs through it.

encodedlogistics:optical_multiplexer_rac.shift: A 1U rack device: an Optical Multiplexer (8 channels). Its line leaves the rack at any connection point. Crafted from the block.

encodedlogistics:optical_amplifier_rack.shift: A 1U rack device: patched in, it lets optical lines pass through its rack (in at one connection point, out at another), starting their span count again. Crafted from the block.

encodedlogistics:optical_transport_shelf.shift: A 6U rack chassis for long-haul links between two shelves (paired with a Link Card): two Controller Cards and eight line cards - Transponders (a client network each), Mux, Amplifier and Protection Cards (1+1: working and protect paths).

encodedlogistics:chassis_switch.shift: A 10U rack chassis: an L3 Switch built from cards. Two supervisors (a standby takes over at once), eight line cards (Access, Uplink, Routing, Trunk) and four power supplies (it runs on one; degraded below two).

encodedlogistics:blade_enclosure.shift: A 10U rack chassis with sixteen blade slots (Compute, Memory, Fabrication, Storage) and, behind, two Interconnect Modules, two Management Modules and six power supplies. Blades take no rack lanes.

encodedlogistics:supervisor_card.shift: Runs a Chassis Switch. Put two in: the standby takes over the moment the active one fails or is taken out.

encodedlogistics:access_card.shift: A Chassis Switch line card: 48 rack-local lanes for the other devices in its rack, as an L2 Switch gives.

encodedlogistics:uplink_card.shift: A Chassis Switch line card: four Optical Transceiver cages (the Cages tab) for the switch's uplinks; any one keeps it up.

encodedlogistics:routing_card.shift: A Chassis Switch line card: the L3 Switch's routes and QoS; each one adds 128 items a second.

encodedlogistics:trunk_card.shift: A Chassis Switch line card: lets the switch's ports be VLAN trunks.

encodedlogistics:chassis_psu.shift: Powers a Chassis Switch. It runs on one; with fewer than two it's degraded.

encodedlogistics:controller_card.shift: Runs an Optical Transport Shelf. With two, the second takes over if the first fails.

encodedlogistics:transponder_card.shift: An Optical Transport Shelf line card: one client network (use a Link Card holding it on the card) onto one long-haul channel (1-40; set in the shelf's panel).

encodedlogistics:mux_card.shift: An Optical Transport Shelf line card: puts eight transponder channels onto the line (without one, the line carries a single channel).

encodedlogistics:amplifier_card.shift: An Optical Transport Shelf line card: launches the line amplified, giving it a span's more reach before it loses lanes.

encodedlogistics:protection_card.shift: An Optical Transport Shelf line card: 1+1 protection over two separate paths (two fibre runs, or fibre and a Network Bridge pair), switching within a tick. Revertive by default (set in the shelf's panel).

encodedlogistics:compute_blade.shift: A Blade Enclosure blade: 4 crafting threads for its network's rack Scheduler, twice a Compute Server's.

encodedlogistics:memory_blade.shift: A Blade Enclosure blade: 64K job memory for its network's rack Scheduler, twice a Memory Server's.

encodedlogistics:fabrication_blade.shift: A Blade Enclosure blade: crafts at full speed, as a Fabrication Server with both Throughput Modules does, from nine schematic slots of its own (the Fab tab). It runs 4 crafts at once beyond its jobs' threads.

encodedlogistics:storage_blade.shift: A Blade Enclosure blade: opens six Storage Drive bays (the Drives tab) as network storage, as a NAS does.

encodedlogistics:interconnect_module.shift: A Blade Enclosure's rear module: the 64 lanes its blades use. A second one is redundant.

encodedlogistics:blade_psu.shift: Powers a Blade Enclosure. It runs on one; with fewer than two it's degraded.

encodedlogistics:management_module.shift: Runs a Blade Enclosure. A second one is a standby.

encodedlogistics:lto_tape_6.shift: Cold storage for a Tape Library. Keeps what's on it when taken out.

encodedlogistics:lto_tape_7.shift: Cold storage for a Tape Library. Keeps what's on it when taken out; upgrading keeps it too.

encodedlogistics:lto_tape_8.shift: Cold storage for a Tape Library. Keeps what's on it when taken out; upgrading keeps it too.

encodedlogistics:lto_tape_9.shift: Cold storage for a Tape Library. Keeps what's on it when taken out; upgrading keeps it too.

encodedlogistics:lto_tape_10.shift: Cold storage for a Tape Library. Keeps what's on it when taken out; upgrading keeps it too.

encodedlogistics:access_terminal.shift: Browse the network's storage. Mounts on a cable face, or on the face of a network block. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:fabrication_terminal.shift: An Access Terminal with a crafting grid fed from the network.

encodedlogistics:schematic_encoder.shift: A terminal that writes crafting and processing recipes onto Schematic Cards. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:ingress_port.shift: Pulls items from the inventory it faces into the network.

encodedlogistics:egress_port.shift: Pushes the filtered items from the network into the inventory it faces.

encodedlogistics:inventory_tap.shift: Makes the inventory it faces part of the network's storage.

encodedlogistics:threshold_sensor.shift: Emits redstone when the network's count of an item crosses a value.

encodedlogistics:point_to_point_link.shift: Passes items, energy, redstone or lanes straight between paired endpoints. Pick the type and direction, then pair with a Link Card.

encodedlogistics:collector_plane.shift: Breaks the block in front (as an iron pickaxe) and collects dropped items into the network. Joins neighbouring planes. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:deployer_plane.shift: Places blocks or drops items from the network, from its list. Joins neighbouring planes. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:schematic_terminal.shift: A terminal for the network's schematics and crafting jobs: every Fabricator, Gateway, Fabrication Server and Midrange System with its schematics, and each job's progress and steps. Uses one lane.

encodedlogistics:trunk_port.shift: A cable part: VLAN trunking. Carries segments (networks beyond Segment Isolators, added with a Link Card) into the network it's on, so every rack there can put its pooled devices on them. Access or Trunk, with a native segment.
